enhancement_controls.name: Professional Portrait
enhancement_controls.why_ai: An identity-faithful portrait for a work context when a user lacks a studio session.

enhancement_controls.name: LinkedIn Headshot
enhancement_controls.why_ai: A specific head-and-shoulders crop, quiet background and readable eyes for a profile image.

enhancement_controls.name: Improve Lighting
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Repair exposure and white balance without changing the person or scene.

enhancement_controls.name: Improve Image Quality
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Reduce compression and noise while refusing invented facial detail.

enhancement_controls.name: Change Background
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Replace only the environment and match edges, perspective and shadows.

enhancement_controls.name: Change Outfit
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Preview a specified wardrobe change on the actual person and natural body.

enhancement_controls.name: Hairstyle Ideas
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Explore grooming changes while protecting hairline and facial identity.

enhancement_controls.name: Studio Portrait
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Create a controlled lighting/background treatment, distinct from a headshot crop.

enhancement_controls.name: Remove Unwanted Objects
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Remove specified distractions conservatively without deleting ambiguous belongings.

enhancement_controls.name: Restore Old Photo
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Repair physical damage without inventing family history, faces or missing identity.

enhancement_controls.name: Couple Makeover
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Preview styling changes on both supplied people without changing either identity.

enhancement_controls.name: Birthday Photoshoot
enhancement_controls.why_ai: A low-complexity requested birthday setup; useful as an editing control, not featured discovery.

enhancement_controls.name: Wedding Enhancement
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Correct light and colour while keeping real ceremony, jewellery and clothing details.

enhancement_controls.name: Travel Photo Enhancement
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Improve an actual travel image without replacing its authentic landmarks.

enhancement_controls.name: Product Background
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Produce reusable seller backgrounds without redesigning the product.

enhancement_controls.name: Product Photoshoot
enhancement_controls.why_ai: Deliver a clean exact-product presentation for sellers without studio equipment.

photo_builder.reason: A user-directed assembly tool. Style, lighting and framing options do not confer editorial approval; generated outputs are not published library concepts.

reel_builder.action: Reworked generic subtle-movement sequences into subject-specific hook, action and payoff for all supported durations.

improve_prompt_controls.reason: Cinematic/realistic/shorten controls refine existing text. They do not increase distinctiveness_score or automatically approve a concept.
